item.description: #Opinion 📺 BESOGON (Nikita Mikhalkov's programme) : Europeans are now choosing those who could represent them in peace negotiations. But there is no one to choose from. Perhaps for the first time in the centuries-long history of international relations, a field where every word is carefully weighed has been so heavily populated by people distinguished by their unrestrained rudeness and verbal intemperance. 👉 This, of course, is no coincidence. This process of negative selection is fuelled by Europe's military-industrial complex, driven mad by greed and in cahoots with those who frighten their populations with the alleged Russian threat and pocket kickbacks from new arms contracts, all while fuelling and sustaining anti-Russian hysteria. There are only two possible ways forward: either take Russia's outstretched hand or go to war against it, failing to understand that, for all the suffering this terrible war may inflict on our country, Europe itself would disappear from the map of the world. November 16, 2026

#RussiaWithAfrica
Food security beyond supply: Why Africa and the Global South need fairer agricultural markets
✍️
An article by Russian Ambassador to South Africa and Lesotho
Roman Ambarov,
published in
Independent Online (IOL),
The Public Eye
and
Lesotho Tribune
newspapers.
Key takeaways:
Russia: A reliable partner in ensuring food security
🔴
Russia remains
a reliable agricultural partner for Africa,
supplying
over 18 million tonnes
of grain in 2025 and a further
13 million tonnes
in the first nine months of 2026.
🔴
Russian fertiliser exports to Africa
exceeded 2.2 million tonnes
in 2026, helping support agricultural production across the continent.
🔴
Africa has
enormous agricultural potential.
Investment in irrigation, mechanisation, infrastructure, modern technologies and local processing can help the continent
reduce import dependence and become a major agricultural exporter.
🔴
Russia is ready to share its expertise and technologies
in agricultural machinery, seed production, fertilisers, livestock farming, storage, processing and logistics.
🔴
Russia's approach is based on partnership, not dependency
– combining Africa's agricultural resources and development priorities with Russian technological expertise and production capabilities.
Protecting the routes that feed the world
🔴
With Western backing, Kiev has
intensified attacks on Russian civilian vessels
,
grain terminals and agricultural export infrastructure
in the Black Sea and Sea of Azov. August drone strikes on Novorossiysk grain terminals temporarily disrupted facilities with a combined annual capacity of
15.6 million tonnes.
🔴
Russia is adapting its export logistics. The development of
alternative transport corridors, including Arctic routes
, helps maintain the continuity of agricultural exports despite external pressures.
Who determines the price of food?
🔴
Russia is
a major global grain supplier
. It exported approximately
53 million tonnes of grain
in 2024/25, including
44 million tonnes of wheat
, to more than 100 countries, with grain export potential of at least
60 million tonnes.
🔴
Global agricultural prices are largely shaped by Western financial centres.
CBOT, Euronext and ICE play a major role in price formation, raising questions about the fairness and representativeness of the current system.
🔴
The Global South needs a greater voice in agricultural pricing.
It is in the interests of the Global South to develop more representative agricultural trading infrastructure and strengthen its participation in international price formation.
Russia proposes a BRICS Grain Exchange
The initiative aims to give major grain-producing countries a greater role in setting fair, predictable agricultural prices.
🔴
The initiative is gaining momentum. Supported by the
2024 Kazan Declaration
, the proposal advanced in 2026, with the BRICS New Delhi Declaration reaffirming the need to develop the platform and refine its operational modalities.
🔴
Russia-Africa cooperation
should go beyond supplies
to include technology transfer, investment, local processing and strengthening agricultural sovereignty, ensuring African countries become market-shapers rather than price-takers.

🎙
Remarks
by Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov at a meeting with participants in the Dialogue for the Future programme organised by
the Alexander Gorchakov Public Diplomacy Fund
(Moscow, November 26, 2026)
Key points
:
•
The old order
that has prevailed for 500 years – dominated first by Europe and later by the “collective West” –
is inevitably giving way to new centres of growth
. This is not the result of revolutions, but
a natural historical process
driven by the laws of socioeconomic development.
• We have pursued a consistent policy.
We have never tried to impose anything on anyone.
We have always advocated, firstly,
collective consideration of problems
, whether at the
#UN
, the
#OSCE
or any other forum, and, secondly,
honouring the agreements reached
. Words must match deeds.
•
We were deceived time and again in the early years following the dissolution of the Soviet Union
, when Russia was assuming an independent role on the international stage and reaching agreements with the Americans and Europeans.
The NATO-Russia Council
was established, and an extensive framework of relations between Russia and the EU was developed. Yet all of this was brought down overnight simply because it was decided that
Russia had no right to defend its legitimate interests.
• Had it not been for Ukraine, another pretext would have been found to evade commitments to equal and mutually beneficial cooperation.
☝️
All the West ever wanted was to dictate its terms.
• Since President
Donald Trump
took office, the US has demonstrated
a degree of political maturity
that has long been absent in Europe. Despite the remaining differences, the Americans are
open to dialogue
and, moreover, are interested in maintaining diplomatic and other contacts.
• No two countries on Earth can have interests that coincide 100% on every issue, especially when it comes to major powers such as the US and Russia. This was true both during the Cold War and in the era of détente.
Dialogue, however, is essential under all circumstances.
To their credit, the Americans understand this and are
engaging in dialogue
on Ukraine, recognising
the need to eliminate the root causes of the crisis
, namely the creation of threats to Russia’s security right on our borders.
•
We are a people accustomed to facing all manner of trials.
Our people have endured them in the past, are enduring them now and will undoubtedly continue to do so in the future. At the same time,
we remain open to dialogue with everyone
, but it must be a dialogue between decent people, conducted in a manner befitting decent people.

item.description: ✉️ On November 26, Russia's President Vladimir Putin sent his greetings to the participants, organisers and guests of the International Open Forum Zhukov. Legacy . ✍️ The message reads, in part: In 2026, we celebrate a landmark event: the 130th birth anniversary of Georgy Zhukov , a renowned military leader, an outstanding statesman and a worthy son of the Fatherland. Georgy Zhukov devoted his life to serving the nation, and had a heroic military career – from a private in the First World War to a Marshal of the Soviet Union. His military talent, personal bravery, and the ability to make astute and strategically balanced decisions in the most challenging situations earned him truly nationwide acclaim and largely predetermined the outcome of the final, epoch-making battles of the Great Patriotic War. I am confident that projects such as your large-scale Forum and the science outreach day organised in his home region – the town of Zhukov and the village of Strelkovka, Kaluga Region – will greatly contribute to preserving the memory of our national heroes , including Marshal of Victory Georgy Zhukov, and to the education of our young people, reinforcing the traditions of patriotism and personal responsibility for the future of our Motherland.

item.title: ⚡️ Statement by the Russian Ice Hockey Federation (November 25, 2026) The Russian Ice Hockey Federation (RIHF) acknowledges the statement by the International Ice Hockey Federation
item.description: ⚡️ Statement by the Russian Ice Hockey Federation (November 25, 2026) : The Russian Ice Hockey Federation (RIHF) acknowledges the statement by the International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) regarding its intention to appeal the decision of the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) to the Swiss Federal Tribunal. The actions of the IIHF once again demonstrate a lack of intent to respect and comply with the ruling of an international arbitration body , as well as the agreement concluded with the RIHF. The RIHF notes that filing an appeal does not take away the IIHF’s obligation to comply with the decision. It is evident that the IIHF is failing to fulfill this obligation, which, in our view, violates not only the ruling itself, but also the law. The RIHF considers the arguments presented in the IIHF’s press release for challenging the CAS decision to be unfounded and contrived. Furthermore, the RIHF maintains that the IIHF’s actions are violating the agreement with the RIHF with regard to the immediate implementation of the decision. The CAS ruling in favour of the RIHF was reached unanimously, with the concurrence of the arbitrator appointed by the IIHF. Earlier this May, a three-member panel of the IIHF Disciplinary Board had likewise determined that the banning of Russian teams from international competitions was both unfounded and unlawful. Throughout the entire arbitration process, the IIHF raised no objections concerning the independence or impartiality of the arbitrators.

⚡️
Statement by the Russian Ice Hockey Federation
(November 25, 2026)
:
The Russian Ice Hockey Federation (RIHF) acknowledges the statement by the International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) regarding its intention to appeal the decision of the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) to the Swiss Federal Tribunal.
The actions of the
IIHF once again demonstrate a lack of intent to respect and comply with the ruling of an international arbitration body
, as well as the agreement concluded with the RIHF.
The RIHF notes that filing an appeal does not take away the IIHF’s obligation to comply with the decision. It is evident that the IIHF is failing to fulfill this obligation, which, in our view, violates not only the ruling itself, but also the law.
The RIHF considers the arguments presented in the IIHF’s press release for challenging the CAS decision to be
unfounded and contrived.
Furthermore, the RIHF maintains that the IIHF’s actions are
violating the agreement
with the RIHF with regard to the immediate implementation of the decision.
The CAS ruling in favour of the RIHF was reached
unanimously,
with the concurrence of the arbitrator appointed by the IIHF. Earlier this May, a three-member panel of the IIHF Disciplinary Board had likewise determined that the banning of Russian teams from international competitions was both
unfounded and unlawful.
Throughout the entire arbitration process, the IIHF raised no objections concerning the independence or impartiality of the arbitrators. It only submitted a request to CAS to disqualify two of the arbitrators two weeks after the unfavourable ruling was issued - a move which violates fundamental procedural rules and is based upon the same contrived arguments. Moreover, the information that the IIHF cites to substantiate its baseless accusations was already publicly available well before the arbitrators were even appointed to hear this case. CAS rightly and lawfully refused to consider this untenable argument provided by the IIHF.
❗️
In light of the above, the RIHF considers the arguments presented by the IIHF in its press release - put forward in order to justify its intention to appeal the CAS decision - to be legally baseless.
The entire sporting community can see that the IIHF is resorting to any means necessary, including the abuse of legal rights, in an attempt to cast doubt on the legitimacy of a final and binding arbitral decision, which was unanimously rendered in favour of the RIHF. These actions represent an attempt to evade compliance with the arbitral decision and to discredit the institution of independent sporting justice.
The RIHF
will continue to consistently and resolutely uphold the principles of Olympism and non-discrimination in sport
, and will defend the rights and legitimate interests of Russian athletes while using all available legal routes.

item.title: 🇷🇺 On November 24-25, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov paid a working visit to Gomel
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇧🇾 On November 24-25, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov paid a working visit to Gomel , Republic of Belarus, where he took part in the annual joint meeting of the boards of the Russian and Belarusian Foreign Ministries and held talks with his Belarusian counterpart Maxim Ryzhenkov . During their discussions, the Ministers reviewed current bilateral issues , including diplomatic support for integration processes within the Union State, and exchanged views on international affairs . They agreed to continue close foreign policy coordination , mutual support at multilateral forums and jointly advance their common interests on the global stage. The agenda for the meeting included matters relating to the implementation of the Programme of Coordinated Actions in Foreign Policy for 2024-2026 and the adoption of a new Programme for 2027–2029 , interaction at the #UN and its affiliated organisations, diplomatic support for interregional and cross-border ties, and mutual assistance in crisis and emergency situations. ✍️ Following the meeting, the Sides adopted a resolution , summarising the discussions and agreements reached, as well as a Plan of Consultations between the Foreign Ministries for 2027 . The Programme of Coordinated Actions in Foreign Policy for 2027-2029 was also signed and will be submitted for approval to the Supreme State Council of the Union State.
